ns2:course.label: Honors Individual Study
ns2:course.description: Individual investigation of special problems. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: Twelve hours of communication; a grade-point average of 3.50; and consent of head of department.
